title: test(plugin-auth): keep the absolute-limit switch fixture off the one-hour boundary
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X5P75jPsrvBic2pzcJ3eDvb)_

Fixes #31175

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：只改一个测试文件：plugin-auth 里「切换组织时按绝对时长上限判定」那条用例的会话夹具，从「正好 60 分钟前创建」改为「59 分钟前创建」，并补一句注释说明为什么不能贴着上限。
- **为什么改**：上限是 1 小时，判定时会重新读时钟；夹具正好 60 分钟，只要过去 1 毫秒会话就超限被结束，「还没到上限」的断言就红。本地实测：旧夹具在 main 上每次都红，不是偶发。产品判定本身是对的，不动产品代码。
- **风险与回滚**：极低。不改任何发布内容（测试文件不进包），「超限」那条 61 分钟断言原样保留；回滚即还原这一行。
- **先看**：`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/organization-access-policy.test.ts`（L398 夹具与 L421 注释）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/organization-access-policy.test.ts`，预期 19/19 通过。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/organization-access-policy.test.ts`, in the `deployment()` fixture of the "a switch of the active organization is judged against the target's limits" block: the `s1` session row is created 59 minutes ago instead of exactly 60. The "not over yet" comment now says why the fixture must sit clearly inside the limit. The "over" leg (`created_at` 61 minutes ago, expect `ended` with `revoke_reason: absolute_max`) is unchanged, so the test still proves the absolute limit is judged at the switch, on both sides of it.
- The same fixture feeds the idle-timeout case in that block. It judges `last_activity_at` (30 minutes ago, against a 10-minute idle limit) and sets no absolute limit, so 59 vs 60 does not change what it reads.

No product file is touched; `organization-access-policy.ts` and `auth-manager.ts` are as on `main`.

## Why

`AuthManager.judgeSessionSwitch` (`auth-manager.ts` L6352–6355) takes its own `Date.now()` after the fixture is written and ends the session when `now - created_at > absoluteHours * 3_600_000`. A row made `Date.now() - 60 * MIN` against a one-hour limit is over as soon as one millisecond passes between the fixture and the judgment. The product comparison is right; the fixture sat on the boundary. Main went red on it in `Test Core (7/8)` (run 42384924042); locally the base fixture is red on every run (the memory engine's insert and read take well over a millisecond).

## Tests

<details><summary>Acceptance: a 5-second fake-clock advance between fixture and judgment; base fixture red, new fixture green</summary>

Each leg runs `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/organization-access-policy.test.ts -t 'the absolute limit is judged too'` under `os-verify-lock`, with the mutation written by `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor must hit, blob verified, restored to the HEAD blob). The test imports `./auth-manager` from `src/`, so there is no `dist/` hop and no rebuild per leg. The delay is `vi.useFakeTimers({ toFake: ['Date'] }); vi.setSystemTime(Date.now() + 5_000);` inserted on the line of the "not over yet" assertion; it was removed afterwards and is not in the diff.

| leg | fixture | delay | on-disk check | result |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 59 min (head) | none | fixture59=1 fixture60=0 delay=0 | `Tests 1 passed`, exit 0 |
| 0b | 60 min (base) | none | fixture59=0 fixture60=1 delay=0 | `AssertionError: expected 'ended' to be 'admitted'`, exit 1 |
| 1 | 59 min (head) | +5 s | fixture59=1 fixture60=0 delay=1 | `Tests 1 passed`, exit 0 |
| 2 | 60 min (base) | +5 s | fixture59=0 fixture60=1 delay=1 | `AssertionError: expected 'ended' to be 'admitted'`, exit 1 |

Restore proof after the last leg: `git diff HEAD` empty, blob on disk `086c2c08` = HEAD blob `086c2c08`.

A first attempt at legs 1 and 2 was a no-op: the delay replacement still contained the anchor line, so `ablation-replace` refused it ("anchor count moved 1 -> 1") before running anything. It was redone with a replacement that rewrites the anchor line itself; the table above is the second run.
</details>

<details><summary>plugin-auth suite and typecheck at head 228d061a</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth test`: `Test Files 234 passed (234)`, `Tests 4168 passed | 10 skipped (4178)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth typecheck` (tsc, examples, `check:test-typecheck`): `check:test-typecheck: OK`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`. The first run answered exit 2 on `examples/basic-usage.ts` because plugin-auth's own `dist/` was not built yet in the fresh worktree; after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth build` it is green.
- `eslint --no-inline-config packages/plugins/plugin-auth`: exit 0 (plugin-auth has no `lint` script, so a filtered `pnpm lint` would match nothing).
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Same-file boundary sweep (the card's L336–346 `minutesAgo` helper): the four concurrent-cap cases use ages 50/40/1, 5/30, 5/30 and 30/20/1 minutes. They only order sessions by age against count caps (`max_concurrent_sessions_per_user`, `maxConcurrentSessions`); no time limit is judged, so nothing sits on a boundary. The other same-file clock fixture, L291 `hourAgo` (60 minutes) against Alpha's 5-minute idle limit, is far over. No other same-file fix.
- Rest of `plugin-auth/src/**/*.test.ts`, every `Date.now() - N` fixture read against the limit it meets: none equals its limit. Closest reads: `auth-manager.test.ts` L4997 (created 60 minutes ago, but the case judges a 15-minute idle limit with no absolute limit), `session-of-record.test.ts` L313/L332 (12 h and 2 h against an 8 h cap), `auth-manager.mcp-oauth.test.ts` L359/L546 (consent timestamps, no limit judged). Nothing out of scope to file.

## Verification

- Derived gate families (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, 52 commands) run at head, reconciled with `--ran`: 51 exit 0, 1 NOT MEASURED (`pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, exit 3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it needs every package's `dist/` and the worktree built only plugin-auth's closure). `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` first answered exit 3 on the shallow clone and is exit 0 after `git fetch --depth=1 origin 621a4876`. `--ran`: "52 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 51 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED", exit 0. The 16 `--self-test` families are checker health only, not a verdict on this diff.
- `skip-changeset`: plugin-auth `files[]` is `dist`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`. After a build, the new comment text and the test file name have 0 hits there; positive control `judgeSessionSwitch` has 4 hits in `dist`.
